commentary: Indian equities show tentative stabilization as Nifty reclaims 25,000, yet an internal deterministic breadth score of 44 signals a 'WEAK' environment under Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil market-timing rules. While selective Stage 2 breakouts can emerge during initial index turns, low market breadth requires disciplined progressive exposure. Jesse Livermore stressed moving in harmony with the general tape; buying aggressively into weak breadth risks whipsaws. True CANSLIM leaders like Aarti Drugs exhibit massive volume sponsorship and accelerating earnings, but the broader list remains fragmented. AAREYDRUGS.technical: Forming a base with double-bottom characteristics above the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA on 1.49x average volume. Overhead supply from past distribution zones remains heavy.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating margins remain thin at roughly 1.5% and revenue contracted, reflecting weak operational momentum. Capital remains heavily tied up in receivables, failing CANSLIM fundamental criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Violating the 104.11 base low aborts the double-bottom pattern; cut losses immediately.

AARON.technical: Clearing a 20-day high with positive MACD above zero on 1.21x volume. Price is consolidating constructively above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA moving averages.
AARON.fundamental: Strong three-digit profit growth and 22% top-line expansion driven by elevator systems manufacturing. ROCE stands at 18.7% with manageable leverage.
AARON.risk: A breakdown below 134.59 swing low invalidates the breakout; observe strict stop discipline.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Textbook SEPA Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-day high on an explosive 23.57x volume expansion, confirming institutional demand and exceptional relative strength above key moving averages.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM profile with Q2 net profit leaping 83% and sales climbing 27%. EBITDA margins expanded to 16.6% on API backward integration.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails if price slips back below the 441.76 pivot buffer; exit quickly.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Stage 2 advance pushing past 20-day highs above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. RSI 72 confirms assertive momentum without reaching extreme exhaustion.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Financial services powerhouse delivering 38% net profit growth and 32% revenue surge in Q2. Diversified lending and life insurance portfolios drive steady double-digit ROE.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Fails on a drop below 391.92 support; execute stop-loss without hesitation.

ABDL.technical: Rebounding off the rising 21-EMA in a double-bottom pattern near highs. RSI 59 shows steady momentum, but volume confirmation remains required on the neckline push.
ABDL.fundamental: Record volumes exceeding 10 million cases lifted revenue by 16%, though supply chain cost pressures held net profit growth to 10%. ROCE remains robust near 18%.
ABDL.risk: A close below 712.35 invalidates the double-bottom structure; enforce risk exit.

ABSLBANETF.technical: Tracking banking index momentum to print a 20-day high breakout on 1.44x volume, supported by positive MACD and aligned swing lows.
ABSLBANETF.risk: Thesis invalidates if the ETF falls back below 58.68 trailing support.
